choice_data_list:
Um... has Vivlos been in a bad mood 
lately...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Because lately I haven't been able to 
hang out with Trainer-chi at all... and on 
my days off I just end up sleeping from 
exhaustion."

...Come to think of it, with all these 
races back-to-back lately, I feel like I 
haven't had a chance to catch my breath.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go to that Arabian restaurant in 
front of the station~! I gotta have 
baklava and knafeh~! Come on, Trainy, 
pleeeaaase!

Conditioning both body and mind is vital. 
Let's review our upcoming race schedule.
